17-13-0303-C(1) Type 1 Narrative & Plans ~ 1414-16 West 69" Street, Chicago, IL

Proposed Zoning:  B3-2 Community Shopping District
Lot Area: 6,237.5 sq. ft.

Proposed Land Use: The Applicant is proposing to reuse the existing two-story mixed-use
building by establishing approximately 1,320 sq. ft. of retail space at grade
and one (1) residential dwelling unit above. The existing building will
remain 26 ft.-8 in. in height. The subject property is a Transit Served
Location and will be supported by four (4) off-street parking spaces.
Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-0303-D optional Administrative Adjustment and
Variation and pursuant to Secs. 17-13-1003-EE of the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, the Applicant is seeking to increase the off-street parking
requirement for a Transit Served Location to four (4) parking spaces and is
seeking all relief necessary, as allowed by the code, for the attached plans.

(A) _ The Project’s Floor Area Ratio: 3,912 square feet (1.25 FAR)

(B) The Project’s Density (Minimum Lot Area Per D.U.): 6,237.5 square feet per D.U.
(1 residential unit)

(C) *The amount of off-street parking: 4 parking spaces

*The subject property is a designated Transit Served Location (67°-69"-71* Bus
Line Corridor). Pursuant to Sec. 17-13-1003-EE, the Applicant is seeking to
increase the off-street parking requirement to four (4) parking spaces.

(D) Setbacks:
a. Front Setback: 0 feet
b. Side Setbacks:
West Side: 0 feet
East Side: 0 feet
c. Rear Setback: 64 feet

(E) Building Height: 26 feet-8 inches
